patthana12.20:1.1: pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana12.20:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.20:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana12.20:4.1: na saraṇaṃ na avicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.20:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na appītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na napītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na nasukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na naupekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na
patthana12.20:8.1: nakāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na
patthana12.20:9.1: rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na
patthana12.20:10.1: narūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na naarūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na pariyāpannaṃ
patthana12.20:12.1: apariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na
patthana12.20:13.1: niyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na aniyyānikaṃ
patthana12.20:14.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na niyataṃ
patthana12.20:16.1: aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na sauttaraṃ
patthana12.20:18.1: na saraṇo na sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ
patthana12.20:19.1: sabbattha vitthāro. na saraṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:
patthana12.20:20.1: ekaṃ. na araṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na araṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na araṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anuttaro ca na araṇo na anuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā:.
patthana12.20:21.1: na saraṇaṃ na anuttarañca na araṇaṃ na anuttarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:.
patthana12.20:22.1: hetuyā pañca sabbattha vitthāro. sahajātavārampi paccayavārampi nissayavārampi saṃsaṭṭhavārampi sampayuttavārampi pañhāvārampi vitthāretabbaṃ.
